basics.name: Daniel Romero Schellhorn
basics.label: PhD Student
basics.summary: PhD Student at University of Osnabrück in the Hybrid AI Group. Working on combining category theory and neurosymbolic AI in the framework 'NeSyCat'.

work.name: Universität Osnabrück & Universidad Nacional de Costa Rica
work.summary: Managing customer and producer data in a database. Calculating and executing financial concepts like Break-Even Analysis. Part of an agile SCRUM team, serving as SCRUM master using Notion.

work.name: DFKI (Deutsches Forschungszentrum für Künstliche Intelligenz)
work.summary: Using ROS and Python to teach a robot arm to pick up objects. Developing a probability model for merging ontologies with real-world data to modulate object recognition prediction probabilities. Collaborating with colleagues using Python, VS Code, GitLab, and Airflow.

work.name: Georg-August-Universität Göttingen
work.position: System Admin Assistant & Research Assistant & Tutor
work.summary: Maintaining the Linux (NixOS) system structure of the numerical institute. Providing IT support to students, administrative staff, and professors. Using Python and VS Code to restructure data I/O for the 'ProxToolbox' mathematical optimization toolbox. Researching optimization algorithms comparison and proofs of convergence. Tutoring multiple classes in Math, Computer Science, and Philosophy.

courses: M.Sc. Cognitive Science with focus on AI (NLP, Ontologies, Knowledge Representation)
M.Sc. Mathematics (numerical applied math, abstract algebra, category theory)
Thesis: Comparison between EPAPC and PAPC as Methods for Pointwise Quadratically Supportable Convex-Concave Saddle Point Problems
Focus on numerical optimization and category theory applied to AI
